en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical palace-like building covered with ivy, with a colonnaded central entrance and many rectangular windows. Attached on the left is a church-like structure with a steep roof and a tower featuring a clock and an onion-shaped spire. In front is a fenced-off lawn or park; a horse-drawn carriage and a few pedestrians are visible along the street.
